messages:
tara-marketing: Quick plan: tiny OSS refapp + 1 webinar + benchmark blurb. Call it "MiniRef: hands-on inference walkthrough". Goal: launch post, 2 tutorials (setup + deep-dive), live demo, and a HubSpot inbound form. Target week: May 13. Need owners.

josh-devrel: I can own repo and tutorials. Will provide `setup/` and `deep-dive/` dirs, sample.env, and a Makefile. Keep steps < 10 commands.

tara-marketing: Love that. @rafi-eng can you run reproducible perf runs for hosted/dedicated/private? We'll need a short benchmark stat for the hero.

rafi-eng: Yup. Repro script:
```
./run_bench.sh --model redwood/open-7b --seq 512 --concurrency 6 --time 120 --tag miniref_may
```
I'll output p50/p95, tok/s, cost per 1k tokens and put JSON in `bench/miniref_may.json`.

emma-product: For framing: short decision checklist (hosted fast, dedicated predictable, private for compliance). I can draft the POV and a 3-bullet comparison.

nina-ops: HubSpot: I'll create form `miniref_may_signup` with hidden fields `campaign=miniref_may` and `interest=refapp`. Routing: company_size<500 -> SDR queue, otherwise AE. Also add webhook to `/integrations/marketing/inbound`.

josh-devrel: Demo env snippet for README:
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<redacted>"
export REDWOOD_MODEL="redwood/open-7b"
./demo.sh
```
I'll include Docker and Cloud Run quick examples.

tara-marketing: Webinar format: 20m demo (josh), 10m bench highlights (rafi), 10m Q&A. Record and clip two socials: quickstart and cost-vs-latency.

emma-product: I'll write microcopy for social clips and the launch hero lines. Keep CTAs: repo + quickstart + webinar signup.

rafi-eng: Will add a `bench/README.md` explaining variance, instance types, and exact flags. I'll aim to have a headline stat like "~Y% lower unit cost with caching + q4 quant on Dedicated vs Hosted for 512-seq" and paste exact Y here when ready.

nina-ops: Also add UTM `utm_campaign=miniref_may` to webinar page and a follow-up email with repo link.

ci-bot: CI scheduled: `miniref-demo` build at 2024-05-03T03:00:00Z, will push container to ghcr.io/redwood/miniref-demo.

josh-devrel: Question: add troubleshooting appendix for OOMs and driver mismatches? I can add `TROUBLESHOOTING.md`.

emma-product: Yes, add common fixes and links to docs.

tara-marketing: Action items: 1) @josh-devrel repo+demo by Apr 28, 2) @rafi-eng bench results by Apr 30, 3) @emma-product POV+microcopy by Apr 25, 4) @nina-ops HubSpot + webhook by May 6, 5) marketing draft post + webinar page by May 8. I'll create a ticket board.

rafi-eng: Noted. I'll include exact instance specs in the JSON and expected variance notes.

tara-marketing: Great work team 680. I'll post draft copy in this thread when ready.

josh-devrel: :thumbsup:
